promises.label: Camera module capacity expansion
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We will be expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to our captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing, capturing more value add in India.

promises.label: Display module JV trials and production
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The trials will start from beginning of Q3 and mass production will commence from end of Q3, beginning of Q4 this fiscal.

promises.label: Mobile revenue and volume growth outlook
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Over the past few weeks, supply-demand dynamics are becoming more balanced, and we are beginning to see an improvement in customer ordering pattern, and we expect a high-double-digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%. We strongly feel that the momentum will sustain for the balance part of the fiscal year.

promises.label: Longcheer JV operation start
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Our 400,000-square-foot facility for 74:26 Longcheer JV for manufacturing of smartphones and other electronic products is expected to start operations by Q3, which will meaningfully strengthen our execution capabilities.

promises.label: Noida facility operation start
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customers is nearing completion, and we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal.

promises.label: Telecom vertical revenue growth
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We expect this vertical to deliver high double-digit revenue growth in the current fiscal.

promises.label: IT hardware revenue growth multiple
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The segment delivered a healthy performance for the quarter under review, and we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year with a huge uptake in order books from all customers.

promises.label: Inventec JV mass production start
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Our new facility adjacent to our existing facility under our 60:40 JV within Inventec, Taiwan is progressing well and expected to go into mass production in Q3 of the current fiscal.

promises.label: Washing machine front-loading facility launch
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Addition of a new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine, which will be launched by end of Q2 this financial year.

promises.label: Lighting revenue growth
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The JV with Signify continues to deliver strong revenue growth, and we expect the revenues to grow almost to 2x in the current fiscal.

promises.label: IT hardware revenue target
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We feel that our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

promises.label: Q Tech camera module revenue target
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Last year, on an annualized basis, we did a revenue of INR1,700 crores. We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

promises.label: Telecom network revenue target
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27. That's another major trigger of growth.

promises.label: Lighting revenue target
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores. We expect 2x after we have formed the JV with Signify.

promises.label: Mobile revenue vs volume growth difference
promises.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
promises.quote: So we expect Pankaj to -- that the revenue growth should be at least 12% to 15% higher, if not more.

promises.label: Overall company revenue growth target
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat. If Vivo comes in, then it's a very major trigger. We feel that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.
